title: INVESTIGATE — Arena complexity research: 10 categories of level-design enhancements, evaluation, recommendations for variety beyond uniform default
intent: User feedback 2026-06-01: бой на default arena (15×11 uniform odd/even hard-block lattice + uniform soft-block density) feels 'сложновато и не интересно' against bots; will be same vs other players. Current 6 arena variants (default / wide / corridor / plaza / cross / pit / grassland) differ in TOPOLOGY + SIZE but otherwise share the same flat uniform structure. This INVESTIGATE story spec'd to: (1) catalogue 10 categories of arena-design enhancements (density variation, asymmetry, chokepoints, landmarks, multi-zone, dynamic elements, themed hazards, randomness, power-up positioning, bot adaptation), (2) evaluate each per impact / cost / complexity, (3) prototype 2-3 starter approaches, (4) recommend implementation roadmap. Output: `docs/research/arena-complexity-spike.md` covering all categories + selected prototype results + 2-3 follow-up story specs.
rationale: Source: user playtest feedback 2026-06-01. Current arenas exercise the mechanics (bombs/pickups/multi-bot) but don't exercise the DECISION SPACE — players don't have meaningful route choices, terrain advantages, or memorable landmarks. With 9 power-ups + 3 hazards + variable height + ramps shipped, the GAMEPLAY engine is rich; the LEVEL DESIGN is the limiting factor. Investigation needed before committing implementation. Same spike pattern as GDP-2026-05-30-004 (scorch decals investigate).
acceptanceHints: OUTPUT: written analysis at `docs/research/arena-complexity-spike.md` covering 10 categories + prototype results + 2-3 follow-up recommendations.
STEP 1 — CATALOGUE 10 CATEGORIES OF ARENA ENHANCEMENTS:

1. DENSITY VARIATION — soft-block density varies by region. Cluster zones (high block density = high pickup reward), pristine zones (no blocks = fast travel), reward rooms (cul-de-sacs with dense blocks). Currently default uniform ~40%; could vary 10..70% per region.
2. ASYMMETRIC LAYOUTS — different sides of arena have different structure. One side elevated (post height), other flat. Each spawn has unique nearby resource. Disincentivises mirror-match orbit play.
3. CHOKEPOINTS — narrow passages forcing engagement. One-cell-wide corridors between hard-block walls. Bridges over pit areas. Center bottlenecks where main fights happen.

4. VISUAL LANDMARKS — focal points players orient around. Central tower (elevated structure with stairs). Corner fortifications. Special tile clusters (e.g. golden-tile cluster with guaranteed power-up drops).
5. MULTI-ZONE LAYOUTS — distinct regions in one arena. Open plaza centre + maze quadrants + outer hazard ring. Different terrain biome per zone. Forces players to navigate between modes.
6. DYNAMIC ELEMENTS — things that CHANGE mid-round. Regrowing soft blocks (gameplay-systems.md §11 wait verdict). Falling walls. Conveyor cycle direction reversal. Pressure-plate-activated gates.
7. THEMED HAZARDS — arena identity via hazard set. 'Industrial' arena: conveyors + pressure plates. 'Maze' arena: narrow corridors + ramps. 'Volcano' arena: timed lava patches (NEW hazard).

8. RANDOM ELEMENTS — different each match. Per-match random soft-block placement (deterministic per session seed but different across sessions). Random hazard location. Random spawn rotation (player.1 starts at different corner each round).

9. POWER-UP POSITIONING — strategic placement. Guaranteed-drop cells (one per arena, always spawns rare pickup like Pierce / Throw Glove / Shield). Risk-reward zones (good loot in dangerous area like centre near hazards).

10. BOT AI TERRAIN ADAPTATION — bots use terrain strategically. Coward seeks high-ground defensive positions. Hunter chases via ramps. Miner hoards in soft-block-dense zones. (Bot ramps/steps awareness was OOS in original GDP-011/015 — surface for this story.)
STEP 2 — EVALUATE EACH per IMPACT × COST × FIT:
Impact: how much does this make arenas feel 'interesting' (subjective — anchor on the user feedback gap).
Cost: implementation effort (small / medium / large) + risk to existing gameplay.
Fit: how well does it use existing shipped systems vs requiring new ones.
Score each 1-5 on each axis. Rank top 3-4 by combined score.
STEP 3 — PROTOTYPE 2-3 of the TOP-RANKED CATEGORIES. Quick spike work:
Prototype A (suggested): per-region density variation — modify scene file's soft-block authoring to support density-per-region. Render result + bot-play.
Prototype B (suggested): asymmetric layout — one spawn elevated, other flat. Render + bot-vs-bot.
Prototype C (optional): chokepoint arena — 'cross' arena variant where 4 quadrants connect via 1-cell-wide hard-block corridors. Render + bot-vs-bot.
Each prototype scene file lives in examples/kaboom-crew/scenes/ behind a feature-flagged URL.
STEP 4 — RECOMMENDATION DOC. Final section of spike.md:
Recommended approach: top 2-3 categories to ship first.
Path forward: file 2-3 follow-up stories for implementation.
Defer rest to future cycles.
STEP 5 — FILE follow-up stories based on recommendation.
EVALUATION CRITERIA (subjective + objective):
Subjective: does it make a round feel more interesting? (judge from prototype playtest)
Objective: does it expand bot-vs-bot decision tree (more deterministic outcomes vs orbital draw)?
Objective: does it pair with shipped power-ups + hazards naturally?
Subjective: does the visual + tactical read survive on first encounter?
REFERENCE GAMES TO CONSULT:
Super Bomberman R battle arenas — 25+ themed arenas with unique mechanics each.
Bomberman 64 — 3D arenas with elevated platforms (we have variable height + ramps now).
Bombergrounds: Reborn — themed environments (volcano, ice, futuristic).
Brawl Stars maps — asymmetric mode-specific layouts.
Counter-Strike maps — chokepoints + sightlines (different genre but the level-design principles transfer).
Super Smash Bros stages — landmarks + dynamic elements.
EXCLUSIONS — design constraints to respect:
No rule mutations (Move or Die style) — banned per gameplay-systems.md §7.2.
No skull-curse / random debuffs — banned per gameplay-systems.md §5.4.
No live-service progression — banned per gdd.md.
Visual themes already-shipped (warehouse/factory/dock/lab/bunker per GDP-2026-05-28-013) layer on top — arena STRUCTURE is the spike target, not arena VISUAL THEME (already done).
Asymmetric multiplayer roles — currently symmetric per gameplay-systems.md §7.2; investigate could surface 'should we relax this?' but recommendation should stay symmetric.
DELIVERABLES:
docs/research/arena-complexity-spike.md (this story's main output)
Working prototype scene files (kept ephemeral OR merged as flagged feature)
2-3 new stories filed for implementation: e.g. `GDP-2026-06-02-001 — Density variation per arena`, etc.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Production implementation of any approach — only spike research + prototype.
Procedural arena generation (random arenas every match). Defer — too big a bet without playtest.
Per-player asymmetric advantages (different stats per side). Defer — breaks symmetric-start rule.
Mode rotation (capture-the-flag / king-of-the-hill). Different scope; competitor-analysis.md covers mode variety separately.
Custom arena editor / level builder. Defer indefinitely.
AAA-style arena polish (dynamic lighting per zone, scripted moments). Out of scope for indie engine showcase.
